mapper.select: select id, owner_id, owner_name, department_id, department_name, create_time, update_time, user_ids, user_names, group_id, group_name, location, avatar, avatar_img, source, existed FROM tb_create_group WHERE group_id = #{groupId}

SELECT tcg.department_id AS orgCode, count( 1 ) AS count FROM tb_create_group tcg
AND tcg.department_id IN
#{code}
GROUP BY tcg.department_id

SELECT group_id FROM tb_create_group WHERE group_id IN
#{groupId}

SELECT id, owner_id, owner_name, department_id, department_name, create_time, update_time, user_ids, user_names, group_id, group_name, location, avatar, avatar_img, source, existed FROM tb_create_group WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, user_ids) AND existed = 1
AND ( group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR user_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR owner_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') )
ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT tcg.group_id AS groupId, tcg.owner_id AS ownerId, tcg.group_name AS groupName, tcg.user_ids AS userIds, tge.archived AS archived, tge.id AS groupExtendsId, tge.group_type AS groupType, tcg.user_ids as memberIds FROM tb_create_group tcg LEFT JOIN tb_group_extends tge ON tcg.group_id = tge.group_id WHERE tcg.group_id = #{groupId}
